title: Volunteer sign-up received
details: Filled in the volunteer sign-up form and would like to mentor in the Back-End track. Replied with information about the next cohort.

title: Introductory call
details: First call with a new volunteer who heard about HackYourFuture from a colleague. Explained how mentoring works and how much time it takes each week.

title: Question about time commitment
details: Asked on Slack how much time mentoring takes. Explained it is about four hours a week, including the weekly session and homework reviews.

title: Matched with a module
details: Discussed which part of the programme suits them best. Their React experience makes them a good fit for the Front-End track.

title: Certificate of conduct requested
details: Asked them to request a certificate of conduct (VOG) before they start working with trainees. Shared the instructions.

title: Certificate of conduct received
details: Received their certificate of conduct (VOG). Everything is in place for them to start mentoring next week.

title: Volunteer agreement signed
details: Returned the signed volunteer agreement, including the confidentiality terms for trainee data.

title: Welcome email
details: Sent the welcome email with the mentor guide, the cohort schedule and who to contact with questions.

title: Slack invite sent
details: Sent an invite to the HackYourFuture Slack and added them to the mentors channel and the channel of their cohort.

title: GitHub access
details: Asked for access to the HackYourFuture GitHub organisation to review pull requests. Added them to the mentors team.

title: Onboarding session
details: Joined the volunteer onboarding at Codam. Went through the code of conduct, the learning platform and how the weekly sessions work.

title: Shadowed a session
details: Shadowed an experienced mentor during the weekly session before teaching on their own. They felt well prepared afterwards.

title: Feedback on onboarding
details: Found the onboarding clear, but would have liked to meet the other mentors before their first session.

title: First class taught
details: Taught their first class on JavaScript fundamentals. The trainees were engaged and the session finished on time.

title: Check-in after first month
details: Checked in after their first month of mentoring. They enjoy it, but would like more guidance on how detailed homework reviews should be.

title: Check-in: going well
details: Regular check-in. Mentoring is going well, they get along with the other mentors and want to continue with the next module.

title: Check-in: feeling stretched
details: They feel stretched between work and mentoring. Agreed they will teach every other week and another mentor covers the rest.

title: Question about the curriculum
details: Asked where to find the learning goals for next week. Shared the module page on the learning platform.

title: Slides for the session
details: Asked for last year's slides on CSS layouts to prepare their session. Shared the folder with the session materials.

title: Session schedule shared
details: Sent the schedule of the upcoming module with the dates they agreed to teach. They confirmed all of them.

title: Session swap
details: Asked to swap sessions with another mentor because of a work trip. Updated the schedule and let the cohort know.

title: Can't make this week's session
details: Messaged that they are sick and cannot make this week's session. Found another mentor to take over.

title: Covered a session last minute
details: Stepped in to teach the weekly session when the scheduled mentor got sick. Thanked them for the flexibility.

title: Tech hour reminder
details: Reminded them about the tech hour they signed up to host this week. They confirmed they will be there.

title: Tech hour hosted
details: Hosted a tech hour and helped five trainees debug their homework. Most questions were about asynchronous code.

title: Pair programming session
details: Ran a pair programming session in which trainees built a small REST API together.

title: Code review workshop
details: Ran a code review workshop for the cohort. Trainees practised giving feedback on each other's pull requests.

title: Testing workshop
details: Gave a workshop on unit testing for the Tester track. Trainees wrote their first automated tests.

title: Planning a workshop
details: Planned a workshop on web accessibility for the Front-End track. Agreed on the date, the exercises and what trainees should prepare.

title: Specialization track planning
details: Planned the Cloud track together. They will teach the sessions on Docker and Kubernetes and help with the final assignment.

title: Session materials shared
details: Shared the slides and code examples of their session, so they can be added to the learning platform.

title: Asked for session feedback
details: Asked whether the trainees liked their session on REST APIs. Shared the results of the session survey with them.

title: Positive trainee feedback
details: Trainees rated their session highly. They appreciated the clear explanations and the live coding examples.

title: Session moved too fast
details: Several trainees said the session moved too fast. Shared the feedback and suggested more breaks for questions.

title: Feedback from co-mentor
details: Their co-mentor shared that they always come well prepared and explain concepts clearly.

title: Late to sessions
details: Trainees mentioned they arrived late to the last two sessions. Discussed it with them and they will plan their travel better.

title: Discussed a difficult session
details: Talked through a session where the group was hard to keep focused. Shared tips for timeboxing exercises and keeping discussions on track.

title: Question about homework submissions
details: Asked how to see which trainees handed in their homework. Explained where to find the submitted pull requests.

title: Homework review backlog
details: Mentioned they are behind on reviewing homework pull requests. Asked another mentor to help with this week's reviews.

title: Trainees find reviews helpful
details: Trainees said their homework reviews are detailed and help them write cleaner code.

title: Reviews too short
details: Some trainees found their homework reviews too short. Shared a few examples of detailed reviews with them.

title: Question about grading
details: Asked how to grade the mid-term assignment. Shared the assessment criteria and an example of a good review.

title: Concern about a trainee
details: Called to share concerns about a trainee who missed the last two sessions. Passed it on to the trainee's coordinator, who will reach out.

title: Follow-up on trainee concern
details: Followed up on the trainee they were worried about. The trainee is back in class and catching up with the homework.

title: Trainee asked for extra help
details: A trainee asked them for extra help with React hooks. They offered an online one-on-one session this week.

title: Laptop for a trainee
details: Offered their old laptop for a trainee who does not have one. Arranged the handover at the next session.

title: Mentor feedback on cohort
details: Shared that the cohort is motivated, but struggles with Git. Planned an extra Git workshop before the next module.

title: Curriculum feedback
details: Thinks the database module has too much content for one week. Suggested moving SQL joins to a separate session.

title: Proposed curriculum improvement
details: Proposed updating the Node.js exercises to the latest Express version. Forwarded the proposal to the curriculum team.

title: Learning platform suggestion
details: Suggested making the exercises on the learning platform easier to find. Passed it on to the curriculum team.

title: Wrote documentation
details: Wrote a setup guide for the Cloud track exercises. It is now part of the learning platform.

title: Fixed curriculum issues
details: Opened pull requests to fix broken links and typos in the curriculum repository.

title: Shared a useful resource
details: Shared an article about teaching Git to beginners in the mentors channel. Several mentors found it useful.

title: Access to the learning platform
details: Could not log in to the learning platform to prepare their session. Fixed their account and they could access it again.

title: Mid-term interview panel
details: Joined the panel for the Core Program mid-term interviews. Interviewed four trainees and wrote a short report for each.

title: Interview reports submitted
details: Submitted clear reports with scores for the mid-term interviews. Asked them to add examples of what went well.

title: Final project kick-off
details: Joined the final project kick-off as a technical mentor. Helped two teams scope their project ideas.

title: Final project mentoring update
details: Their final project team works well together, but needs help with deployment. Shared the deployment guide of the Cloud track.

title: Demo day jury
details: Was part of the jury on demo day. Gave thoughtful feedback on every final project presentation.

title: CV review session
details: Reviewed CVs with trainees during job preparation. Most CVs needed clearer descriptions of the projects.

title: LinkedIn workshop
details: Gave a workshop on building a strong LinkedIn profile. Trainees updated their headlines and summaries during the session.

title: Salary negotiation talk
details: Gave a talk on salary negotiation and employment contracts in the Netherlands. Trainees asked lots of questions.

title: English conversation practice
details: Led an English conversation group. Trainees practised introducing themselves and their projects for job interviews.

title: English mentoring progress
details: Their mentee is more confident speaking English in class. They suggest continuing the mentoring for one more month.

title: HR mentoring match
details: Matched them as HR mentor with a trainee preparing for the Dutch job market. Explained what we expect and how often to meet.

title: Mock interview
details: Did an online technical mock interview with a graduate. Shared notes with the job preparation team on how the graduate explained their final project.

title: Mock interview feedback
details: The graduate found the mock interview very useful. The questions were close to a real interview they had a week later.

title: Offered to mentor a graduate
details: Offered to support a graduate during their job search. Matched them with a recent graduate of the Data track.

title: Graduate mentoring update
details: Their mentee has two job interviews lined up. They meet every two weeks to prepare.

title: Job opening at their company
details: Shared a junior developer vacancy at their company. Forwarded it to the job preparation team for the graduates.

title: Referral for a graduate
details: Referred one of our graduates for an open position on their team. They will let us know how the first interview goes.

title: Guest talk
details: Gave a guest talk about their own career switch into tech. Trainees found it very inspiring.

title: Availability for the next cohort
details: Asked about their availability for the next cohort. They can teach two sessions in the second half of the Core Program.

title: Reduced availability
details: Their new job leaves less time for volunteering. They prefer to host an occasional tech hour instead of mentoring a full module.

title: Pausing for a few months
details: Let us know they are pausing their volunteering for three months because of a busy period at work.

title: Parental leave
details: They are going on parental leave and will not be available for the coming months. Will check in when they are back.

title: Back from a break
details: Called after their break. They are ready to mentor again and would like to join the Back-End track of the next cohort.

title: Returning volunteer
details: Wants to come back after a year away. Sent an overview of what changed in the curriculum since they last mentored.

title: No response to availability check
details: Did not respond to the last two availability checks. Will not plan them in for the next cohort.

title: Stopped volunteering
details: They decided to stop volunteering after moving abroad. Thanked them for two years of mentoring.

title: Offboarding call
details: Offboarding call to hear about their experience. They enjoyed mentoring, but want to focus on their studies this year.

title: Exit feedback
details: Said in the exit survey that preparing sessions took more time than expected. Suggested sharing session plans earlier.

title: Mentor meetup
details: Joined the mentor meetup to share teaching tips and discuss the plans for the curriculum.

title: Lead mentor role
details: Asked whether they would like to be the lead mentor for the next Core Program. They accepted and will help onboard the new mentors.

title: Graduation ceremony
details: Attended the graduation ceremony of the cohort they mentored and gave a short speech for the graduates.

title: Volunteer drinks
details: Came to the volunteer drinks after the graduation ceremony. Talked about mentoring in the next specialization track.

title: Thank-you note
details: Sent a thank-you note for mentoring the whole Core Program. Trainees mentioned them in the end of module survey.

title: Volunteer of the month
details: Featured as volunteer of the month in the newsletter for all their homework reviews this module.

title: Volunteer certificate
details: Sent a letter confirming their volunteer work at HackYourFuture, which they asked for their employer.

title: Yearly volunteer survey
details: Sent the yearly volunteer survey. They replied with detailed feedback about the onboarding and the curriculum.

title: Recommended a colleague
details: Recommended a colleague who wants to become a mentor. Sent the colleague the link to the volunteer sign-up form.

title: Recruited colleagues
details: Brought two colleagues to the volunteer information evening. Both want to start as mentors.

title: Company volunteering day
details: Organised a volunteering day with their team at work. They reviewed homework and held mock interviews.

title: Employer matches volunteer hours
details: Their employer donates to charity for every volunteer hour. Sent them the details they need to register their hours.

title: Donated laptops
details: Their company donated five refurbished laptops for trainees who need one.

title: Media interview
details: Agreed to be interviewed for an article about volunteering at HackYourFuture.

title: Travel expenses
details: Sent their travel expenses for the sessions at Codam. Forwarded them to finance for reimbursement.

title: Trouble getting into the building
details: Could not get into the building for the weekly session at Codam. Shared the entrance instructions for next time.

title: Updated contact details
details: Shared their new phone number and email address after changing jobs.

title: Code of conduct concern
details: Reported a code of conduct concern from a session. Followed up with everyone involved and closed the case.
